title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo, to Be Known as the Leon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo, to Be Known as the Leon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Leon, Tỉnh Iloilo được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Leon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Leon, จังหวัด Iloilo ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Leon
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kotamadya Leon, Provinsi Iloilo dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Leon
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Leon, Wilayah Iloilo dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Leon

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in the Municipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo, to be known as the Leon National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
